bio.en: State Minister leading Somalia's political coordination on East African Community affairs. The QA prototype gives his EAC mandate high visibility while keeping the platform institution-led and service-focused.
bio.so: Wasiirka Gobolka ee hogaaminaya isku-duwidda siyaasadeed ee Soomaaliya ee arrimaha Bulshada Bariga Afrika. Tijaabada QA waxay siinaysaa waajibaadkiisa EAC muuqaal sare, iyadoo mareeggu yahay mid hay'ad ku hoggaamisa oo adeegga u hiilinaya.
bio.sw: Waziri wa Nchi anayeongoza uratibu wa kisiasa wa Somalia kuhusu Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki. Mfumo wa QA unaweka wazi wajibu wake wa EAC huku ukiendelea kuongozwa na taasisi na kuzingatia huduma.

title.en: Somalia solidifies integration into the East African Community at high-level meetings
title.so: Soomaaliya waxay xoojinaysaa isku-dhafka EAC ee shirarka heerka sare
title.sw: Somalia inaimarisha ujumuishaji wake katika Jumuiya ya Afrika Mashariki kupitia mikutano ya ngazi ya juu

summary.en: State Minister H.E. Ali Mohamed Omar leads Somalia's delegation at EAC Council meetings on the integration roadmap, Secretariat recruitment and passport standards.
summary.so: Wasiirka Gobolka Mudane Cali Maxamed Cumar ayaa hogaaminaya waftiga Soomaaliya ee shirarka Golaha EAC ee khariidadda isku-dhafka, shaqaalaynta Xoghaynta iyo heerarka baasaboorka.
summary.sw: Waziri wa Nchi Mhe. Ali Mohamed Omar anaongoza ujumbe wa Somalia katika mikutano ya Baraza la EAC kuhusu ramani ya ujumuishaji, ajira za Sekretarieti na viwango vya pasipoti.

body.en:
Somalia continues to deepen its EAC engagement as a high-level delegation led by State Minister of Foreign Affairs and Minister for EAC Affairs, H.E. Ali Mohamed Omar, takes part in Sectoral Council and Council of Ministers meetings.

Agenda items include Somalia's integration roadmap, recruitment of Somali nationals into the EAC Secretariat, alignment of the national passport with EAC standards, and progress on non-tariff barriers.

Source: SONNA. Photo credit: SONNA / MFA EAC Affairs coverage.
body.so:
Soomaaliya waxay sii wadaysaa xoojinta ka-qaybgalka EAC iyadoo wafti heer sare ah oo uu hogaaminayo Wasiirka Gobolka ee Arrimaha Dibadda & Arrimaha EAC, Mudane Cali Maxamed Cumar, ka qaybgalayo shirarka Golaha Wasiirrada.

Ajendaha waxaa ka mid ah khariidadda isku-dhafka, shaqaalaynta Soomaalida ee Xoghaynta EAC, iswaafajinta baasaboorka, iyo caqabadaha aan canshuuraha ahayn.

Ilaha: SONNA.
body.sw:
Somalia inaendelea kuimarisha ushiriki wake katika EAC huku ujumbe wa ngazi ya juu ukiongozwa na Waziri wa Nchi wa Mambo ya Nje na Masuala ya EAC, Mhe. Ali Mohamed Omar, ukishiriki mikutano ya Baraza la Mawaziri.

Ajenda inajumuisha ramani ya ujumuishaji, ajira za raia wa Somalia katika Sekretarieti ya EAC, kuoanisha pasipoti, na vizuizi visivyo vya ushuru.

Chanzo: SONNA.

title.en: We are ready to join the Community, Somalia President says
title.so: Waxaan diyaar u nahay inaan ku biirno Bulshada, ayuu yiri Madaxweynaha Soomaaliya
title.sw: Tuko tayari kujiunga na Jumuiya, Rais wa Somalia anasema

summary.en: H.E. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud urged the EAC to fast-track Somalia's admission during the Secretary General's visit to Mogadishu.
summary.so: Mudane Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud wuxuu ku booriyay EAC inay dedejiso aqbalidda Soomaaliya intii uu Xoghayaha Guud ku sugnaa Muqdisho.
summary.sw: Mhe. Rais Hassan Sheikh Mohamud alihimiza EAC kuharakisha uanachama wa Somalia wakati wa ziara ya Katibu Mkuu mjini Mogadishu.

body.en:
During the EAC Secretary General's maiden visit to Mogadishu, H.E. President Hassan Sheikh Mohamud called for fast-tracking Somalia's verification and admission process so that Somalia could become the eighth Partner State.

The President highlighted Somalia's historic, cultural and commercial links with East Africa, and the strategic value of Somalia's coastline and blue economy for the wider Community.

Source: EAC Secretariat press release. Photo credit: EAC Secretariat.
body.so:
Intii uu Xoghayaha Guud ee EAC booqashadiisii ugu horreysay ku yimid Muqdisho, Mudane Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud wuxuu ku baaqay in la dedejiyo habka xaqiijinta iyo aqbalidda si Soomaaliya u noqoto xubinta 8aad.

Madaxweynaha wuxuu xusay xiriirrada taariikheed, dhaqanka iyo ganacsiga ee Bariga Afrika, iyo qiimaha xeebaha iyo dhaqaalaha buluugga ah.

Ilaha: EAC Secretariat.
body.sw:
Wakati wa ziara ya kwanza ya Katibu Mkuu wa EAC mjini Mogadishu, Mhe. Rais Hassan Sheikh Mohamud alitaka kuharakishwa kwa uthibitishaji na uanachama ili Somalia iwe Nchi Mshirika ya nane.

Rais alisisitiza uhusiano wa kihistoria, kitamaduni na kibiashara na Afrika Mashariki, pamoja na umuhimu wa pwani na uchumi wa bluu.

Chanzo: EAC Secretariat.

title.en: Somali officials deepen Partner State engagement across East Africa
title.so: Mas'uuliyiinta Soomaaliyeed oo xoojinaya iskaashiga Dawladaha EAC
title.sw: Maafisa wa Somalia wanaimarisha ushirikiano na Nchi Washirika Afrika Mashariki

summary.en: Officials representing Somalia continue working-level engagement with Partner States on trade, mobility and institutional cooperation.
summary.so: Mas'uuliyiinta matalaya Soomaaliya waxay sii wadaan wadahadalada heerka shaqada ee ganacsiga, dhaqdhaqaaqa iyo iskaashiga hay'adaha.
summary.sw: Maafisa wanaowakilisha Somalia wanaendelea na ushirikiano wa kiufundi kuhusu biashara, uhamaji na ushirikiano wa kitaasisi.

body.en:
Somalia's EAC Affairs teams continue technical and political engagement with Partner States to implement accession commitments and open practical pathways for traders, students and institutions.

Related services on this portal include the integration tracker, trade guidance and citizen mobility pages.
body.so:
Kooxaha Arrimaha EAC ee Soomaaliya waxay sii wadaan iskaashi farsamo iyo siyaasadeed si loo hirgeliyo ballanqaadyada xubinnimada una furmo dariiqyo ganacsatada, ardayda iyo hay'adaha.

Adeegyada la xidhiidha waxaa ka mid ah raadinta isku-dhafka, tilmaanta ganacsiga iyo bogagga dhaqdhaqaaqa.
body.sw:
Timu za Masuala ya EAC za Somalia zinaendelea na ushirikiano wa kiufundi na kisiasa ili kutekeleza ahadi za uanachama na kufungua njia kwa wafanyabiashara, wanafunzi na taasisi.

Huduma zinazohusiana ni kifuatiliaji cha ujumuishaji, mwongozo wa biashara na kurasa za uhamaji.
